description: Returns a list of artists together with their albums. Supports filtering, ordering and pagination. The required `client_id` API key must be provided. The `format` parameter controls the response format (xml, json, jsonpretty). The `order` parameter accepts multiple fields and supports `_asc`/`_desc` suffixes. Setting `fullcount=true` adds a total‑count header but may impact performance. Limits are capped at 200 rows; the special keyword `all` is still limited to 200.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a JavaScript callback (JSONP). Only works with `format=json` and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, maximum 200. The keyword 'all' is also capped at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append `_asc` or `_desc` to each field; ascending is default, but popularity fields default to descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds `results_fullcount` to the response header (perf impact).

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search an artist by name (wildcard pattern).

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on the artist joining date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: album_datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on album release date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Desired album cover size in pixels.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request such as status, code, warnings and results count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of artist objects, each containing its basic info and an `albums` array.

notes: `order` fields that are popularity metrics ignore an explicit `_asc` suffix and always sort descending.
The `limit` parameter cannot exceed 200; using `all` still returns a maximum of 200 rows.
`fullcount=true` adds a heavy header and should be used only when necessary.
